items.label: 1. Farmhouse Style
items.value: The rich natural oak brown finish highlights authentic wood grain, adding timeless rustic elegance to your farmhouse or modern living space. Perfectly anchors your living room layout

items.label: 2. Stable Construction
items.value: Engineered with solid construction and reinforced legs for exceptional durability and wobble-free support. Holds decorative items, lamps, and daily essentials securely

items.label: 3. Ample Storage Space
items.value: Its spacious tabletop and open design provide generous room for storing baskets, books, and decor, keeping daily clutter neatly out of sight in entryways or behind sofas

items.label: 4. Versatile Extra-Long Design
items.value: The Epecoya console table fits perfectly behind most couches, in hallways, apartment entryways, or under windows. Its length makes it ideal for filling empty wall spaces stylishly

items.label: 5. Easy Assembly
items.value: Includes all hardware and clear instructions for straightforward setup. Quickly transform your hallway, living room, or entrance with this functional heavy-duty table
